scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [03:45] when customer voiced extreme panic regarding isolated hill farm livestock safety and veterinary communication loss.

grader.scenario: Overhead drop cable severed by falling tree branch on rural lane during storm
grader.notes: Solid technical fault booking for external overhead drop wire damage, but agent failed empathy when customer voiced severe anxiety regarding isolated hill farm livestock safety.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net fault reporting customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Gemma throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute distress regarding hill farm isolation and veterinary emergency risks; agent completely ignored feelings and cited Openreach matrix rules.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the severed drop wire and loss of service accurately at [01:30].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed farm landline number without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent secured next-morning specialist cherry-picker appointment and provided reference ENG-44019-W.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous and safety-conscious tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked targeted safety and diagnostic questions regarding cable obstruction and roadside risks.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed next-morning engineer appointment agreed and noted reference code.
